title: Define semantic tool call schema and router
purpose: Replace arbitrary shell access with typed semantic tools that can be classified, approved, audited, sandboxed, and recovered.
scope: Define schemas for svc.logs, svc.status, http.check, config.test, fs.read, fs.write.diff, svc.restart, audit.show, and rollback.trigger.
Implement a router that validates tool names and normalized parameters before dispatch.
Reject unknown tools and shell.exec in normal mode.
Record tool version, normalized parameters, and routing decision.
acceptance_criteria: Normal mode has no generic shell.exec route.
Every accepted tool call is schema-validated and canonicalized.
Rejected tool calls include a clear policy-safe reason.
At least three read-only tools and one write-with-diff tool are represented.
verification: cargo run -p agentd -- --route-tool svc.logs service=nginx last=200
cargo run -p agentd -- --route-tool fs.write.diff path=/etc/nginx/nginx.conf content_hash=abc
risk_notes: The schema is the system's tool boundary; avoid loose passthrough fields.
